# 10 Wire control-flow blocks into render() end to end, extend demo

## Outcome

`render()` correctly handles `sequenceDiagram` sources containing any combination of the seven
block kinds, nested arbitrarily, with no changes needed to `index.ts` itself (the dispatch added
in ticket 05 is already generic over statement content — this ticket is integration verification,
not new wiring). `demos/sequence-diagram.html` is extended to also exercise every block kind.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render()` on a real `sequenceDiagram` source containing all seven block kinds (some
  nested) mounts a correctly structured SVG — verified end to end, not just at each stage's unit
  seam.
- [ ] `render()` on a source with a block missing its `end` returns the parser's error diagnostic
  and does not throw.
- [ ] `demos/sequence-diagram.html` visibly shows at least one example of every block kind,
  including one nested example (e.g. `alt` inside a `loop`), opened in a browser.

## Test seam

`render(source: string, container: HTMLElement, options?): SirenRenderResult` — integration test
under jsdom, extending ticket 05's test file.

- `packages/core/src/index.test.ts`
- `demos/sequence-diagram.html`
